title: Slow English Podcast #348: 20 Easy Facts About Cape Verde

sentences.text: you are here today. Today, we will learn about a beautiful island country. The country is
Cape Bird. Some people also call it Cabo Verde. I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Let's begin. Fact 1. Cape Bird is an island country. Cape
Bird is in the Atlantic Ocean. It is off the west coast of Africa. The country is
made up of 10 main islands and several smaller islands. Each island has its own
Fact 2. The capital city is Prya. Prya is the capital and the largest city. It is on
Santiago Island. Many people live and work there. The city has schools, markets,
museums and restaurants. Prya is the political and cultural center of the
country. Fact 3. Cape Bird has beautiful beaches. The country is famous for its
beaches. The sand is soft and the water is clear. Many people enjoy swimming in
the Atlantic Ocean. Visitors also like walking along the beach at sunset. The
warm weather makes the beaches popular all year. Fact 4. Cape Bird has warm
weather. The climate is warm and sunny. There are many sunny days every year. Rain
does not fall very often. The pleasant weather makes outdoor activities easy.
People enjoy the sunshine in every season. Fact 5. The official language is
Portuguese. Portuguese is the official language. Many people also speak Cape
Birdie and Creole. Creole is the language people use every day. Children learn
Portuguese at school. Visitors can also speak English in many tourist areas.
Fact 6. Music is very important. Cape Bird is famous for its music. One famous style
is called Morna. Morna songs are calm and emotional. People also enjoy
funana and coladera music. Music is heard at festivals, family parties and
celebrations. Fact 7. Cape Bird is known for its friendly people. People welcome
visitors with warm smiles. Hospitality is an important tradition. Families enjoy
spending time together. Neighbors often help each other. Visitors usually feel
comfortable and relaxed. Fact 8. Fishing is an important job. The Atlantic Ocean
provides many kinds of fish. Many people work as fishermen. Fresh seafood is common
in local restaurants. Fishing has been important for many generations. The sea
is a big part of everyday life. Fact 9. Cape Birdie and food is delicious. One
famous dish is called Kachupa. Kachupa is made with corn, beans, vegetables and
meat or fish. It is the national dish of Cape Bird. Families often cook it for
special meals. Fresh tropical fruits are also very popular. Fact 10. There are
mountains and volcanoes. Not every island is flat. Some islands have high
mountains. The island of Fogo has an active volcano. The volcano is one of the
country's most famous natural attractions. Many visitors enjoy hiking there. Fact 11.
The ocean is perfect for water sports. People enjoy swimming, diving, surfing and
sailing. The clear water is home to many fish. Some visitors go snorkeling to see
activities. Fact 12. Cape Bird has many beautiful birds. Different birds live on the
islands. Some birds fly across the Atlantic Ocean. Nature lovers enjoy
watching them. The islands are peaceful places for wildlife. Many protected areas
help keep nature safe. Fact 13. Tourism is growing every year. Many visitors come
from Europe and other parts of the world. They enjoy the beaches, sunshine and
local culture. Hotels and restaurants welcome tourists. Tourism is important for
the country's economy. Fact 14. Cape Bird has colorful festivals. People celebrate
with music, dancing and traditional clothes. Carnival is one of the biggest
celebrations. The streets become full of music and happy people. Families and
friends celebrate together. Festivals are full of energy and joy. Fact 15. The
islands have beautiful sunsets. Every evening the sky changes color. The sun
slowly goes down over the Atlantic Ocean. Orange, pink and purple colors fill the
sky. Many people watch the sunset from the beach. It is a peaceful moment. Fact 16. Cape
Bird has unique wildlife. Sea turtles come to some beaches to lay their eggs. Whales
and dolphins can sometimes be seen in the ocean. Many visitors take boat trips to
watch these amazing animals. Nature is one of the country's greatest treasures. Fact 17.
Football is the most popular sport. Children enjoy playing football after school.
Families watch football matches together. The national team has many loyal fans. Sports bring
people together. Football is part of everyday life. Fact 18. Life is peaceful on many islands.
Many towns are small and quiet. People know their neighbors. Life moves at a slower pace.
Visitors often enjoy the relaxed atmosphere. It is a good place to rest and enjoy nature.
Fact 19. Every island is different. Some islands have sandy beaches. Some have green
mountains. Others have volcanic landscapes. Each island offers something special. Many
travelers visit more than one island during their trip. Fact 20. Cape Bird is a wonderful
country to discover. It has beautiful beaches, warm weather,
friendly people, delicious food, and amazing music. The islands are full of natural beauty
and rich culture. Visitors can relax, explore, and learn something new every day. Cape Bird is
one of the most beautiful island countries in the Atlantic Ocean.
